_comment: lib/newer_in_thread.py (返信先より新しい相手の message の判定) の selftest の foil に歯があることを、 判定の部品を 1 つずつ外した mutant で確かめる spec (check-foil-teeth.py が読み、 run-all-checks が毎回回す)。

mutants.name: SENT/DRAFT label を自分と見ない
pairs:
return bool(SELF_LABELS & set(row.get("labels") or []))
    return False
expect_fail: own sent / list copy / own From / draft
expect_pass: newer counterpart after the parent is listed
ack of the newest id: allowed

mutants.name: list が配り直した自分の投稿 (同じ Message-ID) を自分と見ない
pairs: and not (r.get("message_id") and r["message_id"] in own_ids)]
expect_fail: own sent / list copy / own From / draft
expect_pass: each self address counts as own

mutants.name: From が自分の address でも相手に数える
pairs: and parseaddr(r.get("from") or "")[1].lower() not in selves
expect_fail: own sent / list copy / own From / draft
each self address counts as own
expect_pass: newer counterpart after the parent is listed

mutants.name: 返信先より古い message も数える
expect_pass: newer counterpart after the parent is listed

mutants.name: ack を最新でなく何か 1 つの相手 id と照合する
pairs:
return ack == latest, latest
    return ack in {r["id"] for r in newer}, latest
expect_fail: later arrival makes the old ack stale
expect_pass: ack of the newest id: allowed

mutants.name: 返信先が listing に無くても通す (fail open)
pairs:
raise ValueError("Parent not found in its thread listing; cannot check for newer replies")
        base = 0
expect_fail: parent missing from the listing fails closed

mutants.name: 日付の無い row を黙って 0 扱い
expect_pass: parent missing from the listing fails closed
